auth: header x-cron-secret must equal CRON_SECRET of the application (401/403 otherwise)
baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:3001 (the application port; no nginx, no TLS, no rate limit in between)

endpoints.name: daily-reminder
endpoints.why: Pending tasks due today become one reminder per assignee before the sales day starts. One write per assignee per Dubai day (S17).

endpoints.name: check-no-answer
endpoints.why: Three unanswered calls in a row warn the lead owner. Warns again only when a newer follow-up log exists (S17).

endpoints.name: dispatch-sweep
endpoints.why: Lead dispatch states (S24): evaluates leads created in the last seven days with no state and re-evaluates changed ones, at most 200 per run. The route answers Disabled until DISPATCH_SWEEP_ENABLED=true; install the timer only together with the flag. Idempotent: the database routine writes dispatch rows only and a second run changes nothing.

endpoints.name: daily-funnel-snapshot
endpoints.why: End-of-day funnel counts. The route dates the snapshot with the UTC date; 23:50 Dubai is 19:50 UTC, the same calendar date, so the snapshot date equals the Dubai date. It deletes and rewrites today's rows, so reruns are safe.

endpoints.name: daily-digest
endpoints.why: Manager digest. The route answers Disabled until DAILY_DIGEST_ENABLED=true; enable the timer only together with the flag and Sam's approval. Not idempotent: do not run it twice a day.

endpoints.name: check-overdue-installments
endpoints.why: Hermes already calls it at 09:02 Dubai (15 of 15 days in the nginx log). Not taken over: a second caller adds nothing. The unit exists only so the day Hermes stops, this timer can replace it; it is idempotent (existing notifications are skipped, status moves once), so overlap is harmless.

endpoints.name: cleanup-notifications
endpoints.why: Hermes already calls it at 09:02 Dubai. Not taken over. Deleting rows older than 90 days is idempotent.

endpoints.name: check-whatsapp-followups
endpoints.why: Sales follow-up monitor (S21): first response, contacts in 5 working days, follow-up state, system note and notification only when the state changes. The route answers Disabled until WHATSAPP_FOLLOWUP_MONITOR_ENABLED=true; the timer repeats hourly 09:30-19:30 Dubai (extra OnCalendar lines). Idempotent: the database writer only writes on a change.

endpoints.name: check-visit-overdue
endpoints.why: Overdue visit reports (S23): one warning notification per recipient per visit (event key), for open visits whose report was due in the last 14 days. The route answers Disabled until VISIT_OVERDUE_ALERTS_ENABLED=true; install the timer only together with the flag. Idempotent: the database routine writes each event key once.

endpoints.name: check-alerts
endpoints.why: The route is disabled in code (2026-06-27, produced 432 duplicate notifications per call). Never enable the timer until the route has deduplication and this file says so.

endpoints.name: check-overdue-followups
endpoints.why: The route is disabled in code (redundant with check-alerts, no dedup). Same rule as check-alerts.
